candidate.only_change: negative accumulated legal-action regret is clipped to zero instead of retained signed; linear t regret increment, linear strategy averaging and all other training, representation, action, chance, payoff and target-order choices fixed

compute.audit_forecast: 2*ceil_millis(383.04340299998876)+120=886.088<900 from pinned PR116 48-case native job clock; new audit has 24 candidate cases
compute.profile_estimator: T=max over workers of sum over assigned games of max across 3 repeats (whole_path_seconds*40000000/actual_profile_work); admit own only if 2*(2*T+600)<7200
compute.worker_partition: worker 0 dry A/B; worker 1 wet A/B; fixed order

control.source: published PR116 immutable exact-turn path, no retraining; native audited before this study

diagnostic_rows.rule: all published selected_decisions exact_info rows per game, in fixed game order; never substitute a row after candidate outcomes

gates.inconclusive: other complete outcomes or any required correctness, source, compute, publication or audit gate fails
gates.negative: any candidate final absolute/coverage/recall gate fails or any paired final delta >+0.001
gates.positive: all four candidate final linear averages <=0.01 pot fraction, whole coverage >=0.95 and recall violations 0; at least three paired deltas <=-0.001 including one dry and one wet; remaining delta <=+0.001; worst <=0.025

metrics: exact restricted-game NashConv/2 chips and fraction of 36-chip initial pot; 40m linear average primary
each of four paired candidate-minus-control final fractions and all 10m/20m/40m readouts
turn/river additive best-response gains, fixed PR119-ranked row diagnostics with cards/actions/probabilities/reaches/alternative values
whole and post-initial-river coverage, recall, actual charged work and overshoot, runtime, hardware, peak worker RSS, table bytes
all per-game deterministic values, range and worst; no seed confidence interval

prior_basis.contrary_pr100: clipped/linear/linear B4/q8 was negative on both other known games and all six paired seeds
prior_basis.contrary_pr120: signed/uniform/linear was negative on all four PR116 known games at 40m

publication: protocol before any candidate outcome; isolated source exact local/optional/hosted and receipt; fictional proof before real profile; fixed complete profile then separate data-only admission; one candidate own training and published policies/scores before reference audit; fixed report then final exact-source local/optional/hosted, review and history merge
question: Does clipped rather than signed accumulated regret improve exact-turn full-expected play at matched 40m work on all four known PR116 collision-containing medium OOP games?
scope: four already inspected, dependent PR116 medium OOP restricted games; conditional on collision-containing template; no unseen transfer, seed interval, full-game claim or default promotion

selection.rule: use all four PR116 frozen first-eligible dry/wet/dry/wet inputs in fixed order; no new screen or redraw

stopping: a scientific or admission gate failure ends this study; preserve all partials, no retry or budget extension; software defects require retained failure and full requalification; no restart of interrupted candidate path without a prospectively declared resumable complete state (none exists)
